capabilities: Render a GitHub-style heatmap calendar from a DataviewJS block
Customize color schemes and color intensity scaling
Define global color schemes in the settings panel
Show hover previews of linked notes on calendar days
Configure week start day and custom CSS styling
extras: Users must write their own DataviewJS code to collect and pass data; the plugin only adds the renderHeatmapCalendar() function. An example vault with sample code is available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize day-by-day tracked data as a year-overview heatmap calendar.

relations.evidence: To be used with Obsidian Dataview, but could be used standalone or with other plugins
Optionally install plugin Metatable to display metadata/frontmatter in the preview window

summary: Renders a GitHub-style heatmap calendar in notes from data collected with DataviewJS, for tracking habits, exercise, finances and progress over a year.
